gates.name: Interrogate the build artifact
gates.detail: GITHUB_SHA=97194b39f6904ae002ce36027eb0f9ab3300effd npm run build, then GITHUB_SHA=97194b39f6904ae002ce36027eb0f9ab3300effd npx vitest run --config vitest.build.config.ts — Test Files 10 passed (10); Tests 83 passed (83). Duration 18.91s on this, the second of two runs. The first run (same commit, freshly rebuilt) reported Test Files 2 failed | 8 passed (10); Tests 83 passed (83) — every individual test passed, but tests/build/section-layout.test.ts and tests/build/enhancement.test.ts each hit "Hook timed out in 10000ms" inside their afterAll (browser.close()/server.close()), which vitest counts as a file failure despite zero failing assertions. A clean rebuild-and-rerun did not reproduce it. Reported as a flake, not silently discarded: two runs, one flaky failure in the same two Playwright afterAll hooks, one clean pass, no code change between them.
